[IRET.16.1] The compiled Rete network for one source module is carried
as a set of **per-node DSC atoms** — one `AlphaNode` atom per alpha node, one
`BetaNode` per beta node, one `TerminalNode` per terminal node ([RDSC.4a]). There is
**no** single top-level container message. The set carries the full node
graph and the expression trees for all tests and actions; schema
descriptors arrive **separately** via the SCHEMA atom family (below).
